title: Alert rule namespace validation must reject root folder UIDs
answers: Why can I create an alert rule with folderUID set to root/general folder?
Alert rule namespace validation inconsistent between provisioning and k8s API
How to validate that a folderUID is not the root folder for alert rules
Rejecting legacy 'general' folder UID as alert rule namespace
body:
Symptom: alert rule create/update accepted the root folder (empty string, legacy 'general' UID, or canonical root folder UID) as the rule's namespace/folderUID, allowing invalid rule placement.
Root cause: each namespace-resolution path only checked `uid == ""`, missing the legacy and canonical root-folder UID forms - pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/register.go:newFolderValidator, pkg/services/ngalert/provisioning/alert_rules.go:ensureNamespace, pkg/services/ngalert/store/namespace.go:GetNamespaceByUID.
Fix pattern: replace empty-string checks with `folder.IsRootFolderUID(uid)` (covers folder.LegacyRootFolderUID/general and folder.GeneralFolderUID) at every point a client-supplied folderUID is turned into an alert-rule namespace; return models.ErrAlertRuleFailedValidation or folder.ErrAPIInvalidUID accordingly.
Constraints: apply this invariant to any new entry point that resolves an alert-rule folder/namespace (provisioning, ruler, export, testing, k8s API folder validator); do not reintroduce a bare `uid == ""` check since it misses legacy/canonical root UID spellings.
applies: Grafana-managed alert rule namespace/folderUID validation (provisioning service, ngalert store, k8s API folder validator).

Replace all bare uid=="" checks with folder.IsRootFolderUID(uid) calls at every entry point where client-supplied folderUID becomes an alert-rule namespace, returning models.ErrAlertRuleFailedValidation or folder.ErrAPIInvalidUID accordingly. Apply this invariant to provisioning service, ngalert store, k8s API folder validator, and any new entry point; bare string checks miss legacy and canonical root UID forms. Located in pkg/registry/apps/alerting/rules/register.go:newFolderValidator, pkg/services/ngalert/provisioning/alert_rules.go:ensureNamespace, and pkg/services/ngalert/store/namespace.go:GetNamespaceByUID.
